resources.string: Create a stub for the package name
it will make the system believe the app is installed
How it works: A stub is just an empty app with the target package name
Create a blocker for permission declaration with the target package (the blocker itself will have a random package name)
For apps using the AndroidX library, this may create an installation conflict, blocking the installation of target packages while the blocker is installed.
Hi, this app is for installing stubs and blockers for required packages.\n\nPlease grant permissions to work.

If \"Google Play Protect\" interferes with the installation of packages, try solving this problem by disabling Google Play Store app (usually responsible for the blocking interface), as well as Google Play Services and of course Google Services Framework
Open Google Play Store app settings
Open Google Play Services app settings
Open Google Services Framework app settings
If you have trouble disabling them, go to administrator settings and disable the \"Find My Device\" administrator
After disabling these apps, try initiating the installation again
If all this didn\'t help, go to the website\nhttps://keepandroidopen.org\nMay be there you will find a solution to the problem
